title: LUCID：基于LLM符号化结构化过程的可解释无监督社区检测
summary: LUCID是一种利用大语言模型（LLM）引导的可解释、无训练、无监督社区检测方法。受相变动力学启发，采用四阶段流水线：局部视图初始化、多因素合并、多粒度细化、全局视图选择。LLM诱导形式化规则，将隐式知识转化为显式逻辑结构。实验表明，LUCID在真实数据集上达到最先进性能，优于无监督和半监督基线。
summary_en: LUCID is an LLM-guided, interpretable, training-free, unsupervised community detection method. Inspired by phase-transition kinetics, it uses a four-stage pipeline where LLM induces formal rules to translate implicit knowledge into explicit logical structures. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on real-world datasets, outperforming unsupervised and semi-supervised baselines.
